definitions.explanation: The practice of hanging washed laundry to dry inside the house rather than outdoors, common during the rainy season, in winter, or when pollen and privacy are concerns.

examples.english: On rainy days I dry the laundry indoors.

examples.japanese: {部屋干|へやぼ}しだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{生乾|なまがわ}き→生乾き：16268_namagawaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{臭|にお}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Drying indoors can sometimes leave a musty, half-dry smell.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花粉|かふん}→花粉：04372_kafun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{部屋干|へやぼ}し⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: During pollen season, many households dry their laundry indoors.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧ (room) + {干|ぼ}し (drying, from ⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧). The ほ becomes ぼ through rendaku. Can also be used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ({部屋干|へやぼ}し⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {部屋干|へやぼ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{臭|にお}い: the smell of indoor-dried laundry
- {部屋干|へやぼ}し⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧: detergent made for indoor drying

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {外干|そとぼ}し: drying outdoors — the natural opposite
- ⟦{陰干|かげぼ}し→陰干し：26260_kageboshi⟧: drying in the shade — avoiding direct sunlight
